notes.title: Minor Charge! patch
notes.content:
This update fixes some minor game bugs and graphics improvements.
[list]
[*]Improved game speed on older graphics cards
[*]Fixed an issue where the soundtrack would sometimes stutter briefly.
[*]Fixed a bug where sometimes users would not be able to advance through the campaign with older "partial progress" save files.
[/list]

notes.title: Charge level editor released with Steam Workshop integration!
notes.content:
The Charge level editor is now available!  Download puzzles created by the community from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1367680/workshop/]Steam Workshop[/url] or design your own.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39063006/6001cdb654668387d58e90f2136a5a300e878724.png[/img]

The editor lets you create levels using all in-game components and configure which components are available when solving the puzzles.  You can then easily upload the puzzles to Steam Workshop for others to play.  We've included a quick tutorial to help you get started with the editor.

To download Workshop puzzles made by others, just visit the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1367680/workshop/]Steam Workshop page[/url] and subscribe to your favorite puzzles.  Then press the Steam Workshop Puzzles button on the world select menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39063006/2bdc06bdf4cbb4866ebf40f2f95af9e6a0ffda6d.png[/img]

We'll keep a close eye on the community hub and forums and will release patches as quickly as possible if any problems occur.  Currently the editor is only available in English, but we are working on localizing it into other languages.

We also have some new puzzles we’ve designed using the editor that we’ve released on the workshop:
[list]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2367478069]Flipping Charges[/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2367520231]Routing Troubles[/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2366441888]Finite Precision[/url]
[/list]

We love playing our friend's puzzles and we can't wait to see what you come up with.  Hope you'll enjoy the editor and stay tuned for more things to come!
